text.en: Pet owners consistently praise Tracey, Alice, and the entire salon staff for their welcoming demeanour and attentive listening. Clients appreciate how staff take time to discuss individual coat styling preferences, calm nervous pets before grooming sessions, and communicate clearly about each animal's needs.

title.en: High standard of styling and grooming

text.en: Reviewers frequently compliment the quality of full cuts, washes, and hygiene trims, noting that dogs and cats return home looking immaculate and smelling fresh. Many owners mention receiving compliments from neighbours on their pets' coats following appointments at the Shard End grooming parlour.

title.en: Expertise with nervous cats and dogs

text.en: Customers highlight the salon's gentle technique with nervous rescue dogs, reactive pets, and feisty cats. Pet parents share that even animals that usually dislike grooming or ear cleaning remain relaxed and happy, with cats showing affection toward staff thanks to the quiet dedicated rooms and patient handling.

q.en: Does The Pet Palace groom cats as well as dogs?

a.en: Yes, the salon provides specialised cat grooming and styling services in separate animal rooms.

q.en: How do staff handle nervous or reactive pets?

a.en: Reviewers highlight that staff take time to soothe anxious animals and allow outdoor play to ensure pets feel calm.

q.en: Is advance booking required for grooming sessions?

a.en: Appointments are standard, though reviewers occasionally secure same-day slots depending on parlour availability.

q.en: Where is The Pet Palace grooming salon located?

a.en: The salon is situated on Heath Way in Shard End, serving East Birmingham and Solihull pet owners.
